title: feat(ui): resident list footer row — pick each column's calculation from its cell

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Flow: dev-thread rule (maintainer 2026-11-20 09:22:50Z 「所有 p1 都按照新规则执行」): the card thread builds itself; L1 and the isolated L2 run in parallel at hand-back, the maintainer's 09:22Z ruling for every p1 card (deviates from contract-review.md:18 until the skill card lands).

Save-path ruling: record 7045525672 on #35702 (option A). A personal view saves the pick at once; on a shared view a reader who may edit it saves the pick as a draft through the view settings panel's own save, and other readers see it once it is published. The card's acceptance line "another user opening the same view sees it" therefore reads "after publish" for a shared view.

## 维护者速读

- 列表的表格视图最底下多了一行常驻计算行：第一格是记录数，其余各列在有权限改视图的人悬停时出现「计算」，点开按字段类型选合计、平均、最早、最晚、计数等，选完马上显示；页面最底下原来那条「N 条记录」去掉了。
- 属于「列表页重做」专题，按你定的保存方式：个人视图立即保存，共享视图先存草稿、发布后别人才看到。
- 没有改视图权限的人只能看到结果、没有菜单；万一出问题，最坏是某列选的计算没保存上（会弹出保存失败提示），撤回这个改动即可恢复原样。
- 无。

## What changes

- **Resident footer row** (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`). `ObjectGrid` takes `residentSummaryRow` and draws its table's summary row on a flat table even when no column declares a `summary`, led by the record count (`summaryRowLead` lets the host word the count; the list passes its own `list.recordCount`, plural forms included). A grouped grid and the phone card list draw none, as before. `onResidentSummaryRowChange(drawn)` reports whether the row is drawn.
- **Calculation menu.** With `onColumnSummaryPick(field, summary)` (wired only for a reader who may change the view) each footer cell is a `SummaryCellPicker`, justified from its column's `align` (the trigger is a flex box, which the cell's `text-align` does not move): hover shows "Calculate" on an empty cell; a click opens one menu of the calculations the field type allows (`offeredColumnSummaries`: `sum`/`avg`/`min`/`max` by `isAggregateCompatibleWithFieldType`, never on a boolean (`boolean` or `toggle`, the spec's boolean class) or a record-currency amount; the count family on any field; no `count`, the first cell already says it), the current one ticked, None last. The grid draws a pick at once (`summaryPicks`, dropped once the view handed back declares it). `summaryPickFields` limits the menu to the columns the host can save. A host answering `false` (or a promise of it, or a rejection) did not save, and the grid takes the pick back.
- **Display.** `ColumnSummaryResult` gains `name` and `text`; the resident row draws the name in the secondary text colour and the figure in the normal one, a space between, no colon. `min`/`max` over a date read Earliest/Latest (also in the host-footer report path). Currency figures keep `formatCurrency`, unabbreviated.
- **List page** (`@object-ui/plugin-list`). `ListView` passes the resident row to the grid (not in the compact/capped postures, nor for a view with `showRecordCount: false`) and forwards a host `onColumnSummaryPick` and `columnSummaryPickFields`. The record-count bar no longer prints the count while the grid draws it; the data-cap warning stays in the bar.
- **Save** (`@object-ui/app-shell`). A pick saves the column's calculation and nothing else of the reader's layout. `ObjectView` wires `pickSummary`: a personal view → `personalViews.update` with the STORED row's config and the new `columns` (unsaved hides and order never ride along); a shared view → `handleViewConfigSave` (the view settings panel's save, an ADR-0034 draft), for an admin, on a view the overlay read lists (never the fallback "All records" tab of an object with no views). `columnsWithSummary` changes only the picked column's `summary` among the view's own declared columns (every entry in the object form, since `columns` is all names or all objects) and answers `null` for a column the view does not declare; `declaredColumnFields` hands the grid those columns as `summaryPickFields`, so a column the reader added and a view that declares no `columns` offer no menu. A refused save answers `false`; the shared one also restores the prior view draft.
- **i18n.** New `grid.summary` keys in all eleven packs: `earliest`, `latest`, `pageName`, `calculate`, `none`, `menuPercentEmpty`, `menuPercentFilled`.
- Docs: `plugin-grid` README and `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx`. Changeset `35702-footer-calculation-row.md` (patch ×4).

Read first, by risk: `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (the `summaryPicks` state and the `summaryRow` build), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` (`pickSummary` gate and the two save handlers), `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (`recordCountTextShown`).

## Tests

New:
- `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/footerCalculationPicker-35702.test.tsx` — the offer per field type (amount, text, lookup, date, boolean, toggle, unknown); the row drawn with no declaration and reported; no row without the host prop; no menu without `onColumnSummaryPick` while the figure still draws; pick → drawn at once and ticked → None takes it off; Earliest/Latest on a date.
- `plugin-grid/.../footerCalculationPicker-35702.test.tsx` also pins (L1 7048239634): the menu only on `summaryPickFields`, the other cells drawing their figure; a pick taken back when the host answers `false`, resolves `false` or rejects; a saved pick kept.
- `app-shell/src/views/__tests__/columnSummaryWrite-35702.test.ts` — string → object form, object form keeps its `field` override, None deletes; a view declaring `[a, b]` whose reader hid `b` and added `c`: a pick on `a` writes `[{a, summary}, {b}]`, a pick on `c` writes nothing; a view with no declared columns writes nothing; `declaredColumnFields` in the view's order.

Migrated (the count moved from the bar into the footer row's first cell; the date `max` now reads Latest):
- `plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.test.tsx` — 8 tests read the count off `record-count-bar`; they now read `data-table-summary-lead` (same wording, e.g. "3 records") and two assert the bar carries no count.
- `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.recordCountFooter-10636.test.tsx` — the per-locale count wording (en/ru/ar plural forms) is now read off the footer row's lead, and the bar is asserted absent.
- `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/footerSummaryScope-12081.test.tsx` — two date-column `max` assertions: "Max:" → "Latest:".
- e2e: `ui/e2e/list-condition-row-35549.spec.ts`, `ui/e2e/live/user-filters.spec.ts`, `ui/e2e/live/saved-view-filter.spec.ts` read the count off `data-table-summary-lead` instead of `record-count-bar` (not run locally; Build & E2E UI and Live E2E UI run them).

Voided: none. Platform checklist (`docs/qa/platform-checklist`): no item names the record-count bar or the column footer, none changed.

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

On 6243bf8c's tree: the two #35702 test files plus `footerSummaryScope-12081`, `ListView.test.tsx`, `ObjectView.recordCountFooter-10636`, `ObjectView.overlayPatchOnly` — `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 230 passed (230)`; `plugin-grid`, `plugin-list`, `app-shell` `type-check` exit 0 (after a full-DTS rebuild of the spec/client/lint closure); `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed files: the one pre-existing inline-disabled error in `ObjectGrid.tsx` only.

Earlier, on c116220c's tree (before the main merge cf1927d6 and the one-line gate in bd759bb7):

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over the 45 files that pin the footer, the summaries or the count bar (plugin-grid footer/summary suites, every plugin-list and app-shell test naming `record-count-bar` or `data-table-summary`, the i18n parity/identity suites, the two new files): `Test Files 45 passed (45)`, `Tests 882 passed (882)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `plugin-grid` and `plugin-list` `type-check`: exit 0. `app-shell` `type-check`: exit 0 on the full-DTS build; a later re-run after an `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` server build reports errors only in `CommandPalette.tsx` / `AppContent.tsx`, files this PR does not touch (stale `.d.ts` of their imports) — CI's Type Check UI is the reading.
- Declared narrowing: the whole `plugin-grid` + `plugin-list` + `app-shell` suites did not finish locally inside the container's window (stopped after 70 minutes with only the three migrated files red, all fixed since); Test UI runs them in CI.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Card acceptance, as built: a table view with nothing set has the row, the record count first, "Calculate" on hover under an amount; picking Sum shows "Sum $…" over the whole matched set (the existing whole-set read), at once on a personal view, and on a shared view once its draft is published (until then the draft save reloads the list to the published figures, and a second pick before Publish replaces the first in the draft, #35932); None removes it; text columns offer no sum/average, lookups only counts, dates Earliest/Latest; a reader without edit rights sees figures and no menu; filter/search moves the count and figures; no second "N records" on the page; grouped views unchanged. Boolean 是/否: second PR.
- Views a read-only package ships keep the menu, and their save is refused: on the showcase, a pick on `showcase_task.in_progress` answers 403 ("ships in 'com.example.showcase': save it into 'com.example.showcase.custom'"), toasted, and the pick is taken back (`rt-07`). That is the view settings panel's own save call (`handleViewConfigSave` → `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/:name?mode=draft`), refused the same way there; the refusal is by design (the #35600 line), and neither the footer nor the panel offers a way to save into the customization. The menu is not gated on a dotted name, because every stored view is named `object.key`, the console's own saved views included (`showcase_product.team_products`, home `com.example.showcase.custom`): that gate removed the shared path entirely. The overlay rows the list reads carry no package id, so telling a read-only package's view apart would need the adapter to carry it; not done here (follow-up #35933).
- After a shared pick's draft save the page reloads from the published view: every draft save announces a metadata refresh (`persistRuntimeMetadata` → `emitMetadataRefresh`), which remounts `ObjectView`, the panel's save included. The admin sees the pick drawn, then the published figures until Publish (`rt-03`); the pending draft is in the view settings panel's draft bar (`rt-04`). Pre-existing, outside this card (follow-up #35932). Because the remount drops the local draft, the next pick is built on the published view, so a second pick before Publish replaces the first in the draft and only the latest is published; that case (a second draft save before Publish keeps the first one's changes) is added to #35932 as an acceptance item in a comment there, for its body (L2 7049212622).
- A column the reader added for themselves, and every column of a view that declares no `columns`, draw their figure with no menu (the pick could only save by writing the reader's layout into the view).
- `showRecordCount: false` keeps the old behaviour (row only under a declared calculation, no picker), since the row's first cell is the count.
- Overlap: `overlap-check` reports textual conflicts with #35910 (`ObjectView.tsx`, `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`) and #35918 (the same two plus `ui/e2e/list-condition-row-35549.spec.ts`); the later one rebases.
- Follow-ups: #35933 (carry the serving package into the view rows, so a read-only package's view offers no menu), #35932 (a draft save remounts the list, so a shared pick flashes back to the published figures until Publish).

## Verification

Browser (showcase, own backend :43702 + console dev :53702, admin): evidence in `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35702/` — `after-01-resident-row.png` (row, count first, no bar), `after-02-hover-calculate.png`, `after-03-menu-currency.png` (Sum, Avg, Min, Max, Unique, Filled, Empty, Percent filled, Percent empty, None), `after-04-sum-picked.png` ("Sum $328.98"), `after-06-menu-due_date.png` (Earliest, Latest, counts), `after-07-task-picked.png` ("Latest Dec 10"; the 403 toast above). The boolean column's menu lists counts only. NOT MEASURED in the browser: a personal view's save round trip and a published shared draft seen by a second user (no personal or customizable shared view in the seeded showcase); covered by `columnsWithSummary` tests and the existing personal-view / view-panel save paths.

Round trip (L1 7048239634 must-fix 2), same stand, head 6243bf8c's tree, evidence `rt-01`…`rt-07` in the same folder:
- Personal view "My products" (created from the switcher's Add view card, scope My views): pick Sum under Unit Price → `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_personal_view/<id>` 200 with `config.columns` = the stored row's five columns, only `unit_price` gaining `summary: "sum"` → the cell reads "Sum $328.98" → reload → still "Sum $328.98" (`rt-01`, `rt-02`).
- Shared view "Team products" (Add view, scope Shared; stored `showcase_product.team_products` in `com.example.showcase.custom`, its creation draft published first): as admin pick Avg under Unit Price → `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_product.team_products?mode=draft` 200 with only `unit_price` gaining `summary: "avg"` (`rt-03`) → Manage views → the view's settings → the draft bar reads "Pending changes … Click Publish to release" (`rt-04`) → Publish → `POST …/publish` 200, bar gone (`rt-05`) → reload as admin: "Avg $82.25".
- A second, non-admin user (created with the admin create-user door, member of the org) opens Team products: the footer reads "4 records" then "Avg $82.25", and the row has no button, no menu (`rt-06`).
- Package view refusal: `rt-07` above.
- Alignment (L1 7049007771), head ad2d94c5's tree: on Team products with the selection column drawn, the picker's "Avg $82.25" ends at x=1217, where every Unit Price value ends (x=1217) (`rt-08-right-aligned-figure.png`); before the fix it ended ~75px to the left (`rt-05`). Pinned: the picker of a right/center/left column carries `justify-end`/`justify-center`/`justify-start`.

Two-minute check: on a personal view of any object's table, hover under a number column, click "Calculate", pick Sum — the cell reads "Sum <total>" at once, right-aligned under the amounts, and the page foot shows no "N records" line.

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran. `eslint --no-inline-config` over the changed files adds no finding (its one error is a pre-existing inline-disabled line in `ObjectGrid.tsx`); the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
